messages:
alice: heads-up — we're seeing a significant SSE streaming latency regression after the api-proto-update merge (PR #4321). Tail p50->p95 jump, looks like 2-3x on small payloads.
ben: which path? hosted or dedicated? any rollout flags?
alice: reproduced on staging dedicated. Rollout was gradual but we flipped to v3 proto framing at 09:13 and latency spike aligns. CI perf job also started failing: `ci/perf-e2e` shows +180ms median on streaming tests.
carla: @alice can you paste a short trace? rough timeline is fine.
alice: pasted minimal reproducer and a 2-min flame snapshot.

alice: ```
# reproducer
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"short"}'
```

alice: flame (cropped):
```
serialize_frame 42%
stream_chunking_coalesce 18%
kv_cache_lookup 7%
toolcall_marshaller 12%
other 21%
```
ben: serialize_frame at 42% smells like extra copying / header assembly in the new proto.
carla: toolcall_marshaller at 12% is interesting — did the proto change affect toolcall envelope? @david any recent toolcall serialization changes?
david: I touched tool call envelope last sprint (aligned headers) but kept wire format identical. However I did change SSE chunk boundary logic in api-proto-update to include extra header bytes per chunk.
ben: extra header bytes -> smaller chunks -> more syscalls -> higher latency. Also could mess with batching heuristics in the runtime.
alice: profiling shows more frequent KV cache misses at boundary transitions. kv_cache_lookup count up ~30% vs baseline.
carla: Could be because we changed cache key normalization when including header flags. If keys include chunk sequence, cache hits degrade.
david: checking PR diff now — I added `chunk_id` to the per-chunk metadata for easier client reassembly. That likely changed cache key building on the receiver side.
ben: OK hypothesis: per-chunk metadata -> cache key includes chunk_id -> cache miss -> heavier backend compute -> p95 spike.

alice: CI perf logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-18T09:25:12Z perf-e2e streaming_test: median=120ms (+180ms) p95=410ms (+260ms)
2026-03-18T09:25:12Z flame_root=serialize_frame
```

carla: can we bisect to the exact commit in that PR? start with the merge commit and revert hunks.
ben: I'll run a quick bisect on staging image: building images for each commit in PR branch.
david: I can run a targeted unit test that asserts cache keys are stable across frames. Pushing a small patch to test.

ben: update — bisect narrowed to commit 7f9a3d (adds `chunk_id` header and changes `build_stream_frame_key`). Reproduces reliably.
carla: thanks. Suggest two mitigations: 1) revert chunk_id default in server, 2) change cache key builder to exclude transient chunk_id and keep per-request key.

alice: rolling a hotfix revert PR (#4324) that removes chunk_id by default and keeps an opt-in flag. Marking rollout frozen until fix.
david: opened PR, small change: set `X-Chunk-ID` opt-in via header `X-RWD-Chunk-ID: opt-in` and keep cache key as `req_id|model|prefix`.
ben: can we add a quick guard in runtime cache builder to ignore unknown headers (defensive)? I can add a one-line patch and a test.
carla: do it. Also add perf unit to CI that runs streaming microbenchmarks so we catch regressions pre-merge.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging -> canary -> prod. PR #4324 by alice.

alice: canary results: p50 normal, p95 back to baseline. KV cache hitrate restored.
ben: awesome. Did we confirm toolcall marshaller cost went down too?
alice: yes toolcall_marshaller % dropped from 12% -> 5% in the flame.
david: follow-up: I'll add a lint rule to forbid adding per-chunk non-deterministic fields to cache-keyed metadata.
carla: create a postmortem checklist item: add streaming microbench to pre-merge checks + test for cache key stability.

alice: notes for release: revert merged to main, re-run full perf e2e on CI, freeze rollout until green. Keep `chunk_id` behind opt-in flag for now.
ben: tagging eng-runtime on the PR: @eng-runtime please review the cache key defensive change.
alice: thanks everyone. Closing thread once CI green.

sre-ops: monitoring: no further alerts in staging. Prod canary completed successfully at 09:47.

alice: CI green at 10:12, promoted to prod. Closing. :tada:
